name: Vadakkunnathan Temple
description: Ancient Shiva temple at the centre of Thrissur city, set within the Thekkinkadu Maidan grounds.
cultural_significance: The focal point of Thrissur Pooram and an example of traditional Kerala temple architecture, with a koothambalam used for performing arts.

name: Thrissur Pooram
description: Annual temple festival held around the Vadakkunnathan Temple, known for caparisoned elephants, percussion ensembles and the parasol display.
cultural_significance: One of Kerala's best-known temple festivals, associated with Sakthan Thampuran and the participating temples of Thrissur.
date_or_season: April-May (Malayalam month Medam); exact date varies each year

name: Shakthan Thampuran Palace
description: Historic palace in Thrissur associated with Sakthan Thampuran, ruler of the Kingdom of Cochin.
cultural_significance: Linked to the history of Thrissur and the origins of Thrissur Pooram.

name: Archaeological Museum, Thrissur
description: Museum in Thrissur displaying archaeological and historical artefacts of Kerala.
cultural_significance: Preserves tangible heritage of the region.

name: Kerala Kalamandalam
description: Premier institution for Kerala's classical performing arts at Cheruthuruthy, founded in 1930 by the poet Vallathol Narayana Menon.
cultural_significance: Trains students in Kathakali, Koodiyattam, Mohiniyattam and related arts, helping keep these traditions alive.

name: Guruvayur Sri Krishna Temple
description: Major Krishna temple at Guruvayur in Thrissur district.
cultural_significance: One of Kerala's most important pilgrimage centres, with a living tradition of temple rituals and arts.

name: Pulikali
description: Tiger dance in which performers paint their bodies as tigers and leopards and dance to percussion in Thrissur city.
cultural_significance: A signature folk art of Thrissur during the Onam celebrations.
date_or_season: Onam season (August-September); exact date varies each year

name: Koodiyattam
description: Traditional Sanskrit theatre of Kerala, performed in temple theatres (koothambalams). Pinned at Kerala Kalamandalam, a major training and performance centre.
cultural_significance: Recognised by UNESCO as an intangible cultural heritage of humanity.

name: Ilanjithara Melam
description: Large percussion ensemble performed in the Vadakkunnathan Temple compound during Thrissur Pooram.
cultural_significance: A highlight of Thrissur Pooram showcasing Kerala's traditional percussion.
date_or_season: During Thrissur Pooram (April-May); exact date varies

name: Kathakali
description: Classical dance-drama of Kerala known for elaborate costumes, face makeup and expressive gestures. Pinned at Kerala Kalamandalam, a major training and performance centre.
cultural_significance: One of Kerala's best-known classical art forms, taught at Kerala Kalamandalam.

name: Paramekkavu Bhagavathy Temple
description: Temple in Thrissur and one of the two main participants in Thrissur Pooram.
cultural_significance: Central to the Pooram tradition alongside Thiruvambadi.

name: Thiruvambadi Sri Krishna Temple
description: Krishna temple in Thrissur and the other main participant in Thrissur Pooram.
cultural_significance: Central to the Pooram tradition alongside Paramekkavu.

name: Cheraman Juma Masjid
description: Mosque at Kodungallur in Thrissur district, traditionally regarded as one of the oldest mosques in India.
cultural_significance: Reflects Kerala's long history of maritime trade and religious coexistence.

name: Our Lady of Dolours Basilica
description: Large basilica in Thrissur city, a prominent landmark.
cultural_significance: Represents Thrissur's Christian heritage and architectural diversity.

name: Kerala Sangeetha Nataka Akademi
description: State academy for music, dance and drama, based in Thrissur.
cultural_significance: Supports and promotes Kerala's performing arts.

name: Kerala Lalithakala Akademi
description: State academy for visual arts, based in Thrissur.
cultural_significance: Supports Kerala's painters, sculptors and visual artists through exhibitions and programmes.
